trans-unit.source: Granting scholarships to citizens from developing countries (referred to as “scholarship holders”) for studies at Czech public higher education institutions / universities is an important part of the foreign development cooperation of the Czech Republic and is implemented on the basis of Resolution of the Government of the Czech Republic No. 870 as of 27th November 2024 through a joint programme of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (https://msmt.gov.cz/) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (https://mzv.gov.cz/), implemented in cooperation with the Ministry of Health (https://mzd.gov.cz/).
trans-unit.target: Granting scholarships to citizens from developing countries (referred to as “scholarship holders”) for studies at Czech public higher education institutions / universities is an important part of the foreign development cooperation of the Czech Republic and is implemented on the basis of Resolution of the Government of the Czech Republic No. 870 as of 27th November 2024 through a joint programme of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (https://msmt.gov.cz/) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (https://mzv.gov.cz/), implemented in cooperation with the Ministry of Health (https://mzd.gov.cz/).

trans-unit.source: The terms and conditions, as well as the procedures for granting scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic, are governed by the Guidelines for Granting Scholarships of the Government of the Czech Republic (referred to as “Guidelines”), and by the pertinent Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports scholarship programme promoting the studies of foreign nationals in the Czech Republic that is announced by the Minister of Education, Youth and Sports.

trans-unit.source: Specific tasks related to providing for the studies of scholarship holders at universities in accordance with the Guidelines and the Ministry’s scholarship programme are carried out by the Czech National Agency for International Education and Research (https://www.dzs.cz/).

trans-unit.source: The Government of the Czech Republic Scholarship Programme allows applicants who are already regular students enrolled in an accredited study programme at a university in the Czech Republic at the time designated as the deadline for submitting applications to apply for a scholarship. However, their applications are assessed only after applications submitted by applicants from abroad have been considered. Scholarship applications shall be submitted through the online portal available at https://studyin.gov.cz/, where all required documents must also be uploaded. Applicants are then obliged to send a printed and a personally signed application, together with a current confirmation of studies from the university at which they are currently enrolled, to the following address: Ministerstvo zahraničních věcí, Odbor rozvojové spolupráce a humanitární pomoci, Loretánské náměstí 5, 118 00 Praha 1 – Hradčany by 20th December 2026. These applicants do not undergo an interview, however, they are required to complete the admission procedure to study the selected accredited field of study within the deadlines and under the conditions set by the relevant public university in the Czech Republic.

trans-unit.source: Applicants for a scholarship of the Government of the Czech Republic shall submit all required documentation for assessment through their personal account in the online portal available at https://studyin.gov.cz/. Only the following documents must be submitted in paper form: a printed and personally signed application with a current photograph attached, and proof of the highest level of education achieved (as specified below and upon instruction from the Embassy). Applicants who are already studying in the Czech Republic submit only a printed and personally signed application and a current confirmation of studies issued by their university (see Chapter 2 above).
